computation-library-root.name: RateSetting
computation-library-root.description: Dynamic option parameters setting, used for crediting interest calculation.

input.name: scenarios_ga_yield
input.description: Annual yield of the general account

input.name: esg_ap2p_cap
input.description: Annual P2P index rate caps (6 different values), used in dynamic cap calculation

input.name: investment_account
input.description: The type of investment account of the inforce

input.name: esg_strike
input.description: MLSB P2P strike (index rate - spread, at 6 different values), used in dynamic cap calculation

input.name: is_anniversary
input.description: True if index interest is credited at the moment

input.name: inforce_cap
input.description: The index rate cap of the account, applicable when investment_account = 1, 2, 7

input.name: inforce_fixed_rate
input.description: The fixed rate of the account, only applicable to fixed account (investment_account = 0)

input.name: inforce_participation_rate
input.description: The participation rate of the account, applicable when investment_account = 6

input.name: inforce_spread
input.description: The index rate spread of the account, applicable when investment_account = 3, 4, 5

input.name: use_gas_station_rate_setting
input.description: True if using gas station rate setting

result.name: declared_parameter
result.description: Dynamic option parameter used in interest crediting

result.name: option_budget
result.description: The option budget for the interest crediting accounts

result.name: inforce_option_price
result.description: The option price calculated using the latest dynamic option parameter

columns.c:
/*
 Adjusted\sdynamic\soption\sparameter,
 by\sapplying\sgas\sstation\srate\ssetting\srule\s(or\snot)
 */
 
 if\s!reset_rate_now[step]\sthen
 \s\s\s\sreturn\sprev(declared_parameter_calc)
 end
 
 if\s!use_gas_station_rate_setting\sthen
 \s\s\s\sreturn\sindicated_parameter
 end
 
 //\sfor\s5y\sfund,\sdoes\snot\sapply\sthe\s80/20\srule\sat\sthe\sfirst\screditing\sdate
 //\sbecause\sit's\shard\sto\scalculate\sthe\sequivalent\s1y\sindex\scap.
 if\sinvestment_account\s==\s11\sand\sfirst_credit_now[step]\sthen
 \s\s\s\sreturn\sindicated_parameter
 end
 
 return\siif(
 \s\s\s\sis_leq\s==\sDictionary.is_increasing,
 \s\s\s\s0.8\s*\sindicated_parameter\s+\s0.2\s*\sprev(declared_parameter_calc),
 \s\s\s\s0.2\s*\sindicated_parameter\s+\s0.8\s*\sprev(declared_parameter_calc)
 )
